items.title: 产品辨别力对企业长期成功至关重要
items.snippet: 当AI让验证想法成本骤降，产品人更需依靠敏锐判断筛选真正有价值的方向。
items.raw_snippet:
Product ideas once had to overcome the effort required to create them. Research took weeks, prototypes required specialist teams and engineering capacity was scarce.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is removing those barriers. Teams can now produce convincing ideas and working prototypes before anyone has established that customers need them, that they are financially viable or that the organisation can operate them responsibly. [...] A gap exists between what AI can generate and what a business can justify building. AI does not inherently understand an organisation’s customers, priorities, regulatory requirements and operating conditions. Without that context, teams can build workable solutions to the wrong problem. [...] AI products also raise a different evidence bar. Teams must test data quality, key risks and where people must remain in control. The EY Global AI Sentiment Survey, based on more than 18,000 people across 23 markets, found that 16 percent had already used AI that acts on their behalf, while adoption was outpacing trust.

Trust and oversight, therefore, need to be designed into the business case from the start.

## The human-centred AI product strategy framework
